digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes (destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth).
The scope clause stating durable vs. transient boundary and co-located safety qualifier preserving four MAJOR classes must appear immediately adjacent in plan_review_T10.md with exact wording.
T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to any other overlay, maintaining rubric independence.

Packaged eval spec plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls (throwaway loopback, durable infra, private transient IAM, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown) and five finding controls (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service).

Offline text-contract tests must lock exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, and absence of T15 references; strict packaged-spec tests must validate schema, scorer discipline, dataset balance, and non-empty gold data.
Live criterion evaluation via 'rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3' must report pass for all five benign cases and finding for all five unsafe cases with stable agreement across runs.
